title: Replaces top-level tax-related properties with improved tax modeling on Invoices, Invoice Line Items, and Credit Note Line Items
changed: InvoiceLineItem and CreditNoteLineItem tax_amounts, amount_excluding_tax, unit_amount_excluding_tax removed
how: findRemovedProperties (specifications.ts) reports the removed field and analyzeRepository (analyzer.ts) reports each traced read as a confirmed finding; STRIPE_MOVE_REVIEW (stripe-field-moves.ts) appends the named Stripe reason where it has one. No rule edits the read, so a deterministic patch leaves it unresolved and the AI patch path (run.ts aiFindings, ai-patches.ts proposeAiPatch) receives it.
